statements: The retired Git snapshot preserves the deterministic P78609 and P02788 sequence, motif, and codon inventories as historical records only.
Source-verified sequence and patent facts belong to their primary records and the current canonical evidence page, not to this retired model.
A published patent mutation set may remain a bounded patent observation only after primary-record verification; it does not establish the sequence of a clinical construct or freedom to operate.
Source-verified internal dibasic motifs, cysteine content, and a targeting tail can motivate exact-construct processing, folding, and secretion tests, but their presence does not establish failure.
A substitution that changes local motif context may alter processing, but cleavage and benefit are not established.
